units: metres, three.js Y-up (glTF). Pedestal origin = centre of its bottom face, on the desk plane y = 0.

ring.note: ring rests on its band on the pedestal top (lowest vertex at top_y). Euler XYZ deg in Blender Z-up: [0.0, 8.0, 236.0]

filmOffset_or_viewOffset.note: Blender shift_y 0.135 of frame width moves the subject down. In three.js use camera.setViewOffset(fullW, fullH, 0, -0.135*fullW, fullW, fullH) or render to the photo aspect and match by eye.

camera.frame: photo 1818x1037, shown background-size: cover, centred (desktop 1440x900 crops the sides)

key.type: DirectionalLight (or SpotLight) warm, from the lamp: back-right, high

shadow.note: Blender area light Ø50 mm at ~270 mm -> soft penumbra; in three.js use PCFSoftShadowMap or VSM

lights.environment: env/v2-env-paper.exr tinted warm (#FFB87A multiply), intensity ~0.45 for ring reflections

desk.note: transparent shadow catcher over the CSS photo; receives pedestal + ring shadows

proven: Blender Cycles renders in renders/s01-pedestal/ use exactly these values
proposed: three.js light/shadow numbers are a starting point; tune by eye against s01-pedestal-review-1440x900.png
